description: Delete a program by id. By default its child initiatives are detached (kept, unlinked); pass deleteChildren: true to also delete every child initiative and its work items. This is irreversible. Requires `write` scope.

deleteChildren.description: Also delete child initiatives + work items (default false = detach).

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

name: anyforge_delete_program
title: Delete program
